style_lock.standard: Commercial US children's activity and coloring book, black-and-white interior line art.
style_lock.outlines: Thick clean outlines, large colorable regions, no tiny noodle lines.
style_lock.line_weight: Primary outlines 2.0–2.8pt at print size; inner detail 1.2–1.6pt. Faces use simple closed shapes, not hatch shading.
style_lock.cast: Four children plus one dog, consistent across every scene.
style_lock.face_proportions: Large round heads about one-third of child height, simple dot or crescent eyes, small rounded noses, closed smiling mouths. No adult fashion faces, no anime, no photoreal.
style_lock.clothing_logic: Seasonal fall layers only: Mira crewneck sweater, Eli striped long-sleeve, Joy overalls over a t-shirt, Caleb zip hoodie. Shoes stay round-toed. No logos, letters, numbers, or team names on clothes.
style_lock.environment_language: Readable church/fall depth: ground plane, mid-ground props, a far building or trees. Dense enough to color, never a sticker collage.
style_lock.icon_family: Closed colorable props: lantern, pumpkin, apple, leaf, acorn, scarf, basket, Bible, loaf, heart. Same construction on every page.
style_lock.no_text: Generate NO titles, verses, instructions, page numbers, signs, logos, captions, watermarks, or any legible letters or numbers.
style_lock.medium: Ink on paper coloring-book plate, not 3D, not photoreal, not anime, not watercolor wash.
style_lock.composition: One coherent integrated scene. Not a collage, sticker sheet, or pasted strip.

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: Round cheerful face, chin-length dark bob with a small round hair clip on the right, medium-warm skin, simple crewneck sweater, round-toed shoes. Often holds a paper-bag lantern with a candle glow but no writing on the lantern.

cast.name: Eli
cast.look: Short curly hair, medium-deep skin, striped long-sleeve shirt, kind open expression, sneakers.

cast.name: Joy
cast.look: Two puffs with round hair ties (no letters on the ties), lighter skin, overalls over a t-shirt, small boots.

cast.name: Caleb
cast.look: Straight hair with bangs, light-medium skin, zip hoodie, sneakers, gentle posture.

cast.name: Pip
cast.look: Medium scruffy mixed-breed dog, floppy ears, oval collar tag that is completely blank, friendly face, sitting or walking beside the children.
